## About Me  

I am interested in data science, quantifying climate risk, and applying predictive models to healthcare challenges. I am a current Master's Student in Environmental Health Data Science at Columbia University, and graduated with a BA in Environmental Biology from Washington University in St. Louis.  

---

## Key Skills  

* **R** - tidyverse, leaflet, sf, raster/terra, r5r, stats, MASS, caret, tidymodels, shiny
* **Python** - pandas, numpy, statsmodels, scipy.stats, matplotlib, geopandas, pyearth, scikit-learn
* **Data Visualization & Interactive Dashboards** - ggplot2, tmap, Plotly, shiny
* **GIS & Spatial Analysis ArcGIS** - QGIS, spatial data handling in R (sf, raster/terra) and Python (geopandas, rasterio)
* **Statistical & Predictive Modeling** - regression, machine learning, MARS/Earth models, classification, clustering
